display.purpose: Wordmark and rare page titles. Fraunces, wonk 0, soft 20, max 2.75rem.

headline.purpose: The one title on a screen, such as Вход or Статистика.

title.purpose: Panel and dialog titles in Golos Text.

body.purpose: Answers, table cells, and help text. 65 to 75 characters.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav, field labels, and chips. Sentence case.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal forms and menus only. Tinted with terrace ink.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: State changes on background, border, and color. 160ms. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action: enter, save, navigate. Fresh green, one per row.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4b764b; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 12px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3a653b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4b764b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #e7eaec; color: #44484c; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Fresh Green Button
components.description: Same fresh green as the primary. There is no second filled color.
components.css: .ds-btn-rust { background: #4b764b; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 12px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-rust:hover { background: #3a653b; } .ds-btn-rust:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4b764b; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-rust { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Cancel and leave. Surface fill with a gate line.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fafbfc; color: #222427; font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #6e7276; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e7eaec; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4b764b; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above the field. Placeholder uses gate muted so it clears 4.5:1.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #222427; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-input { background: #fafbfc; color: #222427; font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #6e7276; border-radius: 8px; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #44484c; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4b764b; outline: 2px solid #4b764b; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-input { transition: none; } }

components.name: Side Nav
components.description: Stone paper rail. Active link is terrace wash and fresh green.
components.html: СтатистикаПартнёрыБаза знаний
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 208px; padding: 12px; background: #f3f5f6; border-right: 1px solid #6e7276; font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { color: #44484c; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #e7eaec; color: #222427; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4b764b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-link-active { background: #e7eaec; color: #3a653b; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-link { transition: none; } }

components.name: Partner Chip
components.description: A partner type or filter. Selected state is wash plus a green border, not color alone.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip { background: #fafbfc; color: #222427; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #6e7276; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #e7eaec; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4b764b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-selected { background: #e7eaec; color: #3a653b; border-color: #4b764b; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: One job: a form, a table, or a stat. Flat, with a gate line. Dialogs add the ink shadow.
components.html:
Партнёры

Три новых предложения за неделю.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #fafbfc; color: #222427; border: 1px solid #6e7276; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; max-width: 65ch; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-panel-body { font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; } .ds-panel-dialog { box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgb(34 36 39 / 0.14); }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Two gate prongs, then MIKE / BALI GUIDE in temple stone. Once per screen.
components.html: MIKEBALI GUIDE
components.css: .ds-mark { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; margin: 0; color: #2b2e32; background: #f3f5f6; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-mark-gate { display: block; } .ds-mark-name { font-family: Fraunces, 'Iowan Old Style', Palatino, serif; font-weight: 560; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 48, 'SOFT' 20, 'WONK' 0; } .ds-mark-role { font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }

components.name: Share Legend
components.description: Chart series in fixed order, each with a text label. Color is never the only signal.
components.css: .ds-legend { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Golos Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #222427; min-width: 220px; } .ds-legend li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-swatch { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 4px; flex: none; } .ds-legend-num { margin-left: auto; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #44484c; }

narrative.overview:
Mike is the guide at the gate. The interface should feel like that meeting in daylight: dark volcanic stone, and one bright leaf. Density is a working cabinet, not a campaign page. Type does the hospitality. Color is the gate: temple stone for the name and the page, fresh green for the action.

The ground is shade on stone, not the shirt. A tourist reads this on a phone. An admin reads it at a desk. Both need a light field with real contrast. The page is neutral stone grey. It is never linen, cream, sand, or a green wash.

This system rejects the generic slate SaaS dashboard (Segoe UI, blue-gray panels), the luxury Bali resort brochure (gold serif, infinity pool, barefoot-luxury copy), the travel-blog cream and sand template, the neon beach-club / nightlife promo, and the corporate real-estate CRM.
keyCharacteristics: One voice for the Telegram chat, the admin, and the partner cabinet
Neutral stone paper; the linen shirt stays in the portrait
Temple stone carries the name; fresh green is the one filled action
Flat surfaces, a 1px stone line, a shadow only under a dialog
Fraunces for the stitched name and page titles; Golos Text for everything said
Short Russian labels that say what will happen

rules.name: The Not-the-Shirt Rule
rules.body: Linen Shirt (#e7cfb5) is the portrait. It is never a page, panel, input, or button fill. Sand, cream, and a green page wash are the same mistake. The page stays stone grey.

rules.name: The Embroidery Budget Rule
rules.body: Fresh green is the only saturated color. It fills the one action button, marks the current section, and colors the lead count. The wordmark and the page stay stone. Two filled buttons in one row are prohibited.

rules.name: The One Gate Rule
rules.body: Thread gold is the candi mark and nothing else. No gold type, no gold buttons, no gold rules, no gold chart as the only highlight.

rules.name: The Stitch and Speech Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is the embroidery: the wordmark and page titles. Golos Text is the conversation: labels, tables, buttons, and body. Reversing them is prohibited.

rules.name: The Logo Lockup Rule
rules.body: The only all-caps setting is the wordmark: MIKE, then BALI GUIDE. Section titles, buttons, and nav are sentence case. No tracked uppercase eyebrow above a section.

rules.name: The Straight Stitch Rule
rules.body: Fraunces ships with wonk at 0 and softness at 20. A high-contrast fashion serif, a script, or a gold headline is the luxury brochure, and it is out.

rules.name: The Flat Gate Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Depth is a 1px gate line (#6e7276). A shadow appears only under a dialog or a menu. If the shadow looks like a 2014 app, it is too dark and too tight: lighten it toward terrace ink at 14% and keep the blur at 32px.

dos: Do set the page to Warung Paper (#f3f5f6) and body text to Terrace Ink (#222427).
Do use Temple Stone (#2b2e32) for the wordmark and page titles.
Do use Fresh Green (#4b764b) for the filled button, the active nav item, the focus ring, and the lead count.
Do keep panels flat, with a 1px Gate Line (#6e7276) and 24px padding.
Do set Fraunces on the wordmark and page titles, and Golos Text on labels, tables, buttons, and body. Both with Cyrillic.
Do write button labels as a verb plus an object, in Russian, sentence case: "Сохранить партнёра", "Открыть карту".
Do pair every chart color with a text legend.
Do remove color and shadow transitions when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is set.
donts: Don't build the generic slate SaaS dashboard (Segoe UI, gray panels). No slate palette, no default sans as the brand face, no gray-on-gray tables.
Don't drift into a luxury Bali resort brochure: gold serif, infinity pool, barefoot-luxury copy. Thread gold is the 28px gate mark only.
Don't use the travel-blog cream and sand template. Linen Shirt (#e7cfb5) is never a background.
Don't use a neon beach-club / nightlife promo: no cyan, magenta, or purple chart series, no glow, no glass.
Don't look like a corporate real-estate CRM: no dense gray grids, no tiny uppercase headers, no side-stripe alerts.
Don't put two filled buttons in one row, or use rust, gold, or a second green for text or fills.
Don't carry meaning by color alone. Errors need a sentence. Charts need a legend. Selected chips need a state.
Don't animate layout, bounce, or reveal content by hiding it until a class is added.
